div.head: Nor Grið 5
div.ab: And oðera stowa grið is læsse mærþe, aa be stowe mæþe.
[2] And the sanctuary protection of other locations is less in scale, always according to the status of the site.
[Schluss von 1.] 2. Und der Friedensschutz anderer [Kirchen]orte ist von geringerer Ehrenhöhe immer gemäss dem Range des Ortes.
[End of clause 1.] 2. And the peace-protection of other [church] places is of lesser dignity, always according to the rank of the place.
div.note: Clause 2 runs over lines 5–6. Warner could not make out the ‘l’ of ‘[botlea]s’. Liebermann notes that the distinction of whether the injured man lives is missing elsewhere (compare Grið 13).
Rabin’s 2 covers the rows 5, 6; it is given here, in the first.
